errors.text_span: Die dunkelblaue Linie beginnt bei etwa 60 % im Alter von 20 Jahren

In the description of the dark blue line, the final value at age 70 is stated as 5%. However, the chart shows this value to be approximately 10%, similar to the light blue and grey lines.

In the description of the grey line, the final value at age 70 is stated as 5%. The chart shows this value is approximately 10%.
